import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().strip().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:1+n]
    k = data[1+n] if len(data) > 1+n else 0

    if k <= 0 or not arr:
        print()
        return

    # sort by count of 1 bits descending, then by value descending
    arr_sorted = sorted(arr, key=lambda x: (-abs(x).bit_count(), -x))
    # take up to k elements
    result = arr_sorted[:k]
    print(' '.join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
